v2_execution_blueprint.construction_input_rule: Exact canonical English source only. Historical Korean candidates are forbidden as construction input; historical render values are style seeds only.
removal_mask_rule: Operate only inside the exact source-effect bbox for each element.
Derive the effect support from exact source pixels, including antialias/outline/shadow/glow; do not clear the whole rectangle.
Intersect every proposed mask against protected source artwork before reconstruction.
Any source-effect/artwork ambiguity is fail-closed and must not be solved by dilation into protected art.
For transparent/semitransparent sprites reconstruct RGB+alpha together; no black/white/gray cover box, blur, smudge, invented panel, crop or resize.
style_measurement_rule: Normalize exact source to readable display coordinates before lettering.
Measure baseline vector, source effect height, fill/effect colors, stroke hierarchy and signed slant from source pixels.
Record slant_dx_per_dy, signed slant_angle_deg and slant_direction; historical A84 shear values are hints only.
Build Korean lettering natively at source-family scale; flattened-raster resize/Lanczos shrink is forbidden.
Keep final effect-inclusive Korean pixels inside candidate_safe_bbox with the required interior margin, then map to raw flip_y.
v2_execution_blueprint.same_task_completion_trigger: Once exact removal/protected masks, independently passing CLEAN_PLATE and source-style measurements are available, the next producer invocation must continue through Korean render -> measure/refit -> exact RGBA32 DDS encode -> decoded-final self-QA -> English-source comparison -> candidate persistence without another preflight-only stop.
